author: Henry Ketcham
claims: The Gettysburg Address was less than three hundred words long.
The Gettysburg Address was hastily prepared.
The Gettysburg Address was underestimated by its author.
The Gettysburg Address will last as long as the republic shall last.
The Gettysburg Address will last as long as English speech shall endure.
The Gettysburg Address has majesty, classic simplicity, and elegance.
The Gettysburg Address was not regarded by the audience, press, or people of the United States as a production of extraordinary merit at the time of its delivery.
The Gettysburg Address was not commented on as a production of extraordinary merit until after the death of the author.
